strings.name: Renzo Piano
strings.summary: Born into a Genoese building family, Piano trained in Milan and collaborated with Richard Rogers, engineer Peter Rice and others. The Centre Pompidou exposed structure and services; the Menil Collection and Kansai airport explored light, lightweight structures and users' experience. His workshop designs cultural and public buildings through teamwork. He won the 1998 Pritzker Prize, became an Italian senator for life in 2013 and engaged in discussions on improving urban peripheries.
